purpose: Sovereign, signed, fail-closed interoperability between Anunnaki.Live, The General Counsel and Michael Noah.
principles: Each product remains independently operable and owns its own data, authority, audit and execution decisions.
External responses are untrusted until locally validated, cryptographically verified where enabled, replay-checked and admitted.
A Professional Twin represents one identifiable human professional; products, learners and generic agents are never Professional Twins.
Network learning is opt-in, scoped, provenance-preserving and never silently mutates another product's policy.
A product may become more capable when federated but never less functional when disconnected.
Federation-enabled GC and MN require durable local recording before outbound work is sent.

security.replay_rule: A nonce may be admitted once per issuer. Expired or repeated signed messages are rejected.
security.rotation: key_id is explicit so keys can overlap during rotation.

mastery_passport.rule: Mastery evidence never grants licence, reserved status, statutory appointment or execution authority.

disconnect_behavior.GC: Continue local work; queue federation work.
disconnect_behavior.MN: Continue local work; queue federation work.
